This is the start of the classic Magic Sword variation. It has since fallen out of common use as stated on [Sensei's Library](http://senseis.xmp.net/?WhenToUseTheMagicSword). takes territory and the right side and is recommended unless there are mitigating circumstances.
leads to the classical Magic Sword of Muramasa. With a favorable ladder starting from a black stone at , White can always get a good result. White is a little better even with an unfavorable ladder, however.
